entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who, when summoned to a battlefield, tacitly agrees to help his summoner and to take damage in the fight.

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker, when summoned by a green-aligned mage, tacitly agrees to cast spells, overrun foes and take attacks on the summoner's behalf (an explanatory flavor scenario).
events.quote: Garruk has tacitly agreed not only to cast some spells and overrun some faces
